mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which signals an impending economic slowdown and reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 102.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand and rising inflationary pressures, which may prompt the Fed to maintain or tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal fails to generate a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflation that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS ≥ 3.5%, or the joint signal fails to produce a significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the joint signal fails to generate a significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), signals strong economic expansion that increases inflation expectations and prompts the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 > 2.0% and HOUST > 1500.0, or the joint signal fails to produce a significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).
